content.description:
Investopedia Editor-In-Chief Caleb Silver sits down with Yahoo Finance markets and data editor Jared Blikre to cover the biggest stocks he will be watching in 2026, including Oracle (ORCL), Constellation Energy (CEG), Robinhood (HOOD), and Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-A, BRK-B) after CEO Warren Buffett handed over the leadership reins to Greg Abel at the year's start.

Also catch Caleb Silver share some of his 2026 market predictions.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
